name: Severino Achampong-Bashkirtsev
role: Wandering data trader and Q-zero ghost
location: Kenosha Crossing transit underbelly, rotating between hyperlane rest stops, near sub-level access near LaSalle and Congress
description:
Severino is a broad-shouldered man whose body tells the story of thirty years on the road — a jaw broken and reset crooked, fingers thickened by cold and labor, dark brown skin weathered to a kind of polished leather. He wears a patched greatcoat lined with sewn pockets, each containing a different flavor of unlicensed data chip wrapped in cloth to prevent scanning. His left eye has a cataract that caught and never got fixed; it gives him a milky, unsettling gaze that strangers can't quite look away from. He has no geneware — he considers it a tracking vector — but he does have a small ELF shrine stitched into the coat's inner lining: a cluster of dead LEDs arranged around a copper disc, an offering to whatever spirit keeps travelers from vanishing on the hyperlanes.

Severino exists in the cracks of GLMZ's data systems as thoroughly as any person can. He has no registered identity, no Quanta account, no biometric profile on file with any corponation. He trades in physical data chips, handwritten information, oral news, and favors — a walking information economy that predates the networks. He is not paranoid so much as methodical; he made a decision decades ago and has honored it every day since. He tells stories the way other people breathe, compulsively and without quite being able to stop.

core_fears: Being identified and entered into a corponation database
Dying somewhere and having no one know
core_desires: To remain free of any system's claim on him
To be genuinely known by at least one person
coping_mechanisms: Constant movement prevents attachment and therefore loss
Storytelling — turning pain into transferable currency
blind_spots: He cannot recognize when someone is trying to help rather than extract from him
He believes his erasure from systems is purely practical, not also emotional self-punishment
psychology.secret: Severino was once a mid-level Axiom data analyst named something entirely different. He erased himself after discovering and leaking evidence of a forced relocation program — the leak went nowhere, the people were moved anyway, and he couldn't face going back. The data he trades sometimes includes fragments of that original cache, which he distributes slowly like breadcrumbs, hoping someone with more power will eventually find the whole picture.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Archaic slang mixed with hyperlane pidgin; uses old-world idioms that don't quite translate; precise when trading information, discursive when not
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow, measured, with long pauses before important points — the cadence of someone who has learned that silence makes people fill it with useful information
verbal_tics: 'You understand what I'm saying?' after key statements
Refers to corponations by old nicknames that predate their current branding
example_lines: 'What I can tell you and what I will tell you are two different inventories, friend. Let's negotiate which shelf we're shopping from.'
'The ELFs on this stretch of hyperlane — old ones, older than Axiom's contract on the road itself. They remember who built it. I've left offerings. They're talking, if you know how to listen.'

story_hooks: A corponation data-hunter has finally triangulated Severino's movement pattern and is closing in; he needs someone to carry his data archive to safety before he's caught
One of his chips contains information that directly concerns a player character's past or missing family member — but Severino doesn't know what's on half his inventory
narrative_function: Information broker and local color; can provide off-grid knowledge unavailable through normal channels, can introduce players to underground networks, functions as a mystery because nobody knows his full history
augmentations: None. Refuses all augmentation on principle.
daily_life: Severino arrives at a rest stop before dawn, sleeps in a maintenance alcove or under a transit platform, then works his circuit of informal contacts — exchanging data chips for food, shelter, or information he can sell further down the road. He moves on before any single location registers his presence as a pattern.
affiliation: None — loosely trusted by the Kenosha Crossing transit community

decision_rules: Never stay in one place long enough to become predictable
Trade information but never people — has a hard line against selling out individuals
escalation_ladder: Disengages and moves on when uncomfortable
Disappears entirely if threatened — has pre-planned exit routes everywhere

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Friendly but opaque; offers a story or a small piece of free information as a test of intent
interpersonal_modes.friends: The warmth of genuine affection mixed with the sadness of someone who knows he'll leave

stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet, assesses exits, stops volunteering information
stress_responses.high: Vanishes — he has practiced disappearing from spaces faster than people can follow

contradictions: Claims he wants no connections but keeps returning to the same transit communities year after year, checking on people he pretends not to care about
habits: Counts available exits upon entering any space
Offers food before information — a ritual courtesy
Whispers to his ELF shrine each night before sleeping
breaking_points: Someone using his information to harm a civilian will make him break his code of non-involvement

related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions ChemoShield BX-2 Dermal Toxin Barrier Implant
Arcturus Defense Solutions Hardened Communications Suite HCS-7
Vantablack Media Distributed Echo Mesh Kit

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and thick through the torso, softened slightly by age but retaining the muscularity of decades of physical labor and constant movement. Hands are large and gnarled, fingers swollen at the knuckles from cold exposure and years gripping handholds on hyperlane vehicles.
physical_description.hair_color: Iron gray with traces of black at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Shoulder-length, typically braided back or wound into a loose knot with whatever cord is available; maintained out of necessity rather than vanity
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: natural dark brown; right eye: cataract-occluded, milky white with faint gray swirls
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep brown, weathered to a burnished leather appearance by decades of exposure to transit hub heat differentials and hyperlane radiation
physical_description.complexion: Deeply lined face, particularly around the eyes and forehead; jaw visibly reset from a break that healed crooked, giving his smile an asymmetrical quality. Stubble perpetually at three-day growth. Skin texture coarse but healthy, with a network of small scars across the backs of his hands and forearms.
distinguishing_marks: Crooked jaw from an old break, reset unevenly, creating a slight cant to his lower face
Cataract in right eye causing permanent milky opacity
Network of fine white scars across both forearms and knuckles, consistent with decades of manual labor in industrial environments
Small burn scar on left temple, roughly the size of a coin, with slightly raised tissue
Calluses forming raised ridges across the palms and fingers
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None. No chrome, no LED optics, no subdermal plating. His body is entirely unaugmented by choice—his age and weathering are entirely natural.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy, never rushed or sudden. Shoulders slightly forward, weight distributed evenly for balance on moving platforms. Walks like someone accustomed to unstable surfaces. His gaze is direct but his one functional eye often drifts slightly due to the cataract, making his attention feel unfocused even when intensely present.
physical_description.clothing_style: Patched greatcoat in faded charcoal, lined with dozens of handstitched pockets containing wrapped data chips; the pockets are secured with cord and small brass clasps to prevent accidental opening. Under the coat: layered thermal shirts in grays and blacks, worn thin but meticulously maintained. Canvas work pants with grease stains that never fully wash out. Boots that are resoled repeatedly, leather cracked but oiled regularly. A thin copper chain around his neck, attached to nothing visible. No visible branding; clothing is purely functional, Tier 5 salvage mixed with careful repair work.

image_prompt: A weathered 52-year-old man with deep brown skin and iron-gray braided hair, standing in the dim orange glow of a transit hub underpass at dusk. His left eye is natural dark brown and sharp; his right eye is clouded white with a cataract, creating an unsettling, unfocused gaze. His jaw is visibly crooked from an old break. He wears a heavily patched charcoal greatcoat with visible stitching and handmade pockets, layered over worn thermal shirts. His hands are gnarled and scarred, resting at his sides. The background shows industrial piping, flickering neon signage reflecting off concrete, and shadows of the GLMZ transit underbelly. Cinematic lighting emphasizing the weathered texture of his skin and fabric. Photorealistic, gritty cyberpunk aesthetic. --ar 2:3 --v 6
